customManagers.description: Track the pinned zizmor CLI version in the Claude PostToolUse hook as zizmorcore/zizmor, so it lands in the Zizmor group and moves in lockstep with the zizmor.yml `version:` pin and the zizmor-action release. Without this the hook version drifts and audits with a different CLI than CI. See .claude/hooks/zizmor-check.sh.

packageRules.description: Scope ecs-query dependency updates to ecs-deploy component

Trivy - group the CLI version pin (tofu-pre-commit.yml setup-trivy version: input) with the setup-trivy action, gated behind Dependency Dashboard approval and never automerged; a security scanner bump should be vetted before the gate moves. Also stops the phantom pin error: the built-in github-actions manager maps setup-trivy's version: input to a virtual aquasecurity/trivy dep with no digest-pinnable literal in the file, so pinDigests fails it ('Error updating branch: update failure' on renovate/pin-dependencies). Grouping under dashboard approval keeps that pin out of the auto-attempted path. Mirrors isw-kudos/irt-flight-manager.

Zizmor - keep the pinned CLI version and the zizmor-action release moving together in ONE PR, gated behind Dependency Dashboard approval and never automerged. zizmor-action ships a support/versions allowlist mapping each exact CLI version to a vetted image digest; its action.sh dies with 'Unknown version' when the version: input is not in the allowlist bundled by the SHA-pinned action release, and the zizmor CLI publishes ahead of the action. Grouping the CLI dep with the action dep makes Renovate propose both in a single branch. THREE package names: the CLI version: input in zizmor.yml is ALSO claimed by the built-in github-actions manager as the docker dep ghcr.io/zizmorcore/zizmor, distinct from the zizmorcore/zizmor github-releases dep the customManager derives from the same literal. Omitting the ghcr name leaves that docker dep ungated - it falls through to pinDigests + the minor/patch automerge rule, and the pin attempt fails the renovate/pin-dependencies branch ('Error updating branch: update failure'). See isw-kudos/github-actions .github/workflows/zizmor.yml.
